tunables.name: PAIR
tunables.reason: the length of a [lo, hi] pair: the loader's shape check, not tuning

tunables.name: HALF
tunables.reason: one half: the farthest a camp at a ring's mid-radius may scatter and stay inside the ring, a geometric constant, not tuning

tunables.name: ROAM_PER_LEASH
tunables.reason: the spawn row contract's own validation rule (src/core/world/row.ts): roam is at most a third of the leash; a format rule the loader mirrors, not tuning

tunables.name: HASH_SEED
tunables.reason: the FNV-1a 32-bit offset basis: a published hash algorithm's own constant (pinned by its test vectors), not tuning

tunables.name: HASH_PRIME
tunables.reason: the FNV-1a 32-bit prime: a published hash algorithm's own constant (pinned by its test vectors), not tuning

tunables.name: TENTH
tunables.reason: one decimal place: how finely metres are rounded, a format choice, not tuning
